## Runtime metrics
The supplied twenty-request sample contains forty tool attempts. Model usage includes cached input in input and reasoning in output.

## Ranked findings
The synthetic branch has one scenario-local avoidable read; its supplied frequency is one half. These are checker inputs, not measured application savings.

## Proposed design
The oracle proposes thirty logical tool calls instead of forty, with ten non-overlapping saved calls.

No live candidate evaluation or host behavior has been verified. Source meaning, trace correlation and safe reuse require independent review.
